title: fragaria breslingea var. nigra
intro: Fragaria breslingea var. nigra, commonly known as the Black Alpine Strawberry, is a rare and lesser-known species of strawberry native to the high mountains of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to improve digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria breslingea var. nigra include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage, reduce pain and swelling, and prevent the growth of harmful microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
